title: Relation back of amendments.
bodyText:
An amended pleading relates back to the date of the original pleading as provided by the rules of court.

Nothing herein limits or affects section 657-3.
bodyHtml:
§657-3.5  Relation back of amendments.  An amended pleading relates back to the date of the original pleading as provided by the rules of court.

     Nothing herein limits or affects section 657-3. [L 1972, c 105, §1(c)]
